value.rationale: These three examples are canonical counterexamples to smooth rational-point existence on singular Fano surfaces. Their full extension-field profiles and zeta functions give an exact arithmetic description of when the obstruction disappears and what the Frobenius action contributes. This is a natural, complete refinement for the named examples rather than a single-field recount or an arbitrary parameter slice.
